themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints exploded to 135 this week—a 575% spike from the 20-complaint weekly average—with accompanying spikes in curb condition (up 1100%), street sweeping complaints (up 900%), and missing street signs (up 900% two weeks ago), suggesting widespread deterioration across Far Rockaway's road network that may indicate deferred maintenance or storm damage.
evidence: Street condition complaints: 135 THIS WEEK vs. 20.0 weekly average (575% spike, z-score 11.83)
Curb condition complaints: 3 THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Street sweeping complaints: 5 last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% spike, z-score 6.36)
Missing street signs: 5 two weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% spike, z-score 6.36)
reporting_angles: Investigate whether recent weather events (snow/ice noted in top 90-day complaints) or deferred maintenance triggered the sudden spike
Interview DOT about response timeline and whether this reflects a broader citywide pattern or Rockaways-specific issue
Document resident impact: Are potholes creating hazards? Is street sweeping failure affecting sanitation or rodent control?

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage & Overgrowth Surge
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about damaged trees (4 this week, up 256%) and overgrown branches (6 three weeks ago, up 700%) suggest weather-related tree stress or inadequate Parks maintenance, with potential safety and quality-of-life implications across the district.
evidence: Damaged tree complaints: 4 THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average (256% spike, z-score 4.8)
Overgrown tree/branches complaints: 6 three weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 7.94)
Community board has requested park/amenity reconstruction for multiple years—unmet infrastructure need
reporting_angles: Determine if recent weather (ice/snow from top 90-day complaints) caused branch damage and whether Parks has capacity to respond
Check whether overgrowth is blocking sidewalks, creating pedestrian hazards, or affecting sightlines at intersections
Connect to long-standing community board requests for park upgrades—does this signal chronic underinvestment?

themes_detail.label: Noise Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints jumped 292% last week (23 complaints vs. 5.9 weekly average), following a pattern of elevated residential noise (1001 complaints over 90 days), suggesting either temporary event-driven disruption or deteriorating quality-of-life conditions.
evidence: Street/sidewalk noise complaints: 23 last week vs. 5.9 weekly average (292% spike, z-score 6.93)
Residential noise: 1001 complaints over 90-day period (third highest complaint category)
Obstruction complaints also spiked (10 last week vs. 2.6 average, 281% increase)
reporting_angles: Was there a specific event (construction, traffic pattern change, venue opening) that triggered last week's spike?
Interview residents about whether noise is chronic or episodic; identify noise sources (vehicle traffic, commercial activity, nightlife)
Ask NYPD about enforcement patterns and whether complaint volume matches enforcement response

themes_detail.label: Construction Activity Uptick
themes_detail.summary: 387 DOB permits filed in the last 90 days (223 alterations, 120 new buildings) represent significant construction activity in Far Rockaway, which may correlate with noise spikes and street/obstruction complaints but warrants investigation into whether projects are properly permitted and managed.
evidence: 387 DOB filings in last 90 days: 223 alterations, 120 new buildings, 8 demolitions
Obstruction complaints up 281% last week; noise complaints up 292% last week—may reflect active construction
No active ULURP applications on record, suggesting these are smaller-scale projects without major rezoning
reporting_angles: Map the 387 permits geographically—are spikes in noise/street complaints clustered near construction sites?
Verify whether permit holders are maintaining required noise mitigation and street protection measures
Interview residents in active construction zones about quality-of-life impacts
